ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes are primarily white with heavy black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. A prominent vertical black band extends from the peduncle base through the median notch, with feather-like black striations radiating into the white fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe exhibits fine, high-frequency serrations. The right lobe displays more irregular, deeper indentations and higher-amplitude peaks, particularly towards the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved sigmoidal path; convex curvature near the median notch transitioning to a concave sweep toward the tapered, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly 5-8 circular high-contrast white pixels located on the black pigmented region of the right distal tip; smaller isolated white circular spots on the left distal margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent near-vertical black linear markings on the white field of the right lobe; multiple faint diagonal grey/black scratches on the lower interior white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The right distal tip shows significant irregular tissue loss and a jagged edge profile, accompanied by reddish-brown protruding organic material.
other_distinctive_markers: A block-shaped black pigmentation focal point at the junction of the peduncle and the fluke notch.
